episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: While bathing in the public bathhouse his grandfather designed and built, a boy in ancient Rome is momentarily transported to a very strange place.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Rome, 128 A.D. In a golden age of bathhouse innovation, bathhouse architect Lucius tries to come up with fresh ideas that will set his designs apart.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: After Consul Lepidus asks him to build an outdoor bath with a view of Mt. Vesuvius, Lucius suddenly finds himself bathing among strange-looking monkeys.
